description: Test modules still carry docstrings and explanatory comments, against the rule that code is self-explaining.
goal: Remove every docstring and every comment that is not a '# why:' reason, a shebang, an encoding line or a tool directive (noqa, type, pragma, fmt) from the listed scope test files, without changing what any test asserts or how many tests run. Where a removed docstring or comment carried a reason the code cannot show, keep it as a '# why:' comment; where it only described what the code does, rename the test or extract a helper so the code says it. Do not edit conftest.py files. Code is self-explaining: no docstrings and no comments except '# why:' comments that record a reason the code cannot show.
rationale: Existing violations make the self-explaining rule untrue of the test suite; removing them in small slices keeps every change behaviour-preserving.
acceptance_criteria: A test in apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_self_doc_tests_d.py parses each of these files with ast and tokenize and asserts it holds no docstring and no comment other than a '# why:' comment, a shebang, an encoding line or a noqa, type, pragma or fmt directive: apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_ledger_lock.py, apps/sandbox-executor/tests/ci_bookkeeping_fakes.py, apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_doctor_replay.py, apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_init.py, apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_complexity_gate.py, apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_malformed_config_never_crashes.py, apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_preflight.py, apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_review_ensemble.py, apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_review_resolver_failure.py, apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_unique_stage_ids.py, apps/sandbox-executor/tests/cli/test_main.py, apps/sandbox-executor/tests/flow/test_worktree_all_stages.py.
The number of tests collected from each listed file is unchanged, and every test that passed before still passes.
CLI `--help` text, `make help` output, and log or error messages are unchanged.
Each clean-up PR reports the before and after finding count for its slice.
All tests pass via 'uv run pytest' and 'uv run task lint' passes; no module budget changes.
